items.q: The first human and the first Blessed Prophet ﵇.
Our master Adam ﵇ was created from this.
The wife of our master Adam ﵇, named in the reports.
The one who refused to bow to our master Adam ﵇ out of pride.
The Blessed Prophet ﵇ who built the Ark.
The Blessed Prophet ﵇ thrown into a fire that Allah made cool and safe.
The Blessed Prophet ﵇ sent to the people of 'Ad.
The Blessed Prophet ﵇ sent to Thamud, with a she-camel as a sign.
The son of our master Ibrahim ﵇ who helped him raise the foundations of the House.
The son of our master Ibrahim ﵇ whose birth was announced by angels ﵈ to Sarah.
The nephew of our master Ibrahim ﵇, himself a Blessed Prophet ﵇.
Our master Ibrahim ﵇ is called "Khalil Allah", meaning this.
The sons of Adam ﵇ whose story is in Surah al-Ma'idah; the one killed is named this in the reports.
The bird that showed the son of Adam ﵇ how to bury his brother.
The wife of our master Ibrahim ﵇ and mother of our master Isma'il ﵇.
items.src: Sahih al-Bukhari, Book of the Prophets

items.q: The well that sprang up for our lady Hajar ﵍ and baby our master Isma'il ﵇.
items.src: Sahih al-Bukhari, Book of the Prophets

items.q: The two hills our lady Hajar ﵍ ran between, searching for water.
items.src: Sahih al-Bukhari, Book of the Prophets

items.q: Our master Ibrahim ﵇ was commanded in a dream to sacrifice this son, by the most common view.
The animal sent in place of the son of our master Ibrahim ﵇.
The festival that remembers the sacrifice of our master Ibrahim ﵇.
Allah taught our master Adam ﵇ these, which the angels ﵈ did not know.
The tree our master Adam ﵇ and his wife were told not to approach.
items.a: A tree in the Garden (unnamed in the Qur'an)

items.q: The words our master Adam ﵇ received from his Lord were words of this.
The Blessed Prophet ﵇ raised to "a high place", mentioned in Surah Maryam.
Our master Nuh ﵇ called his people for this many years less fifty.
The mountain where the Ark came to rest.
The son of our master Nuh ﵇ who refused to board the Ark.
items.a: Kan'an (named in reports; some say Yam)

items.q: The surah named after our master Nuh ﵇.
The people of our master Hud ﵇ were destroyed by this.
The city of 'Ad "with lofty pillars", named in Surah al-Fajr (meaning).
Thamud carved their houses out of this.
Thamud were destroyed after they did this to the she-camel.
Our master Ibrahim ﵇ broke the idols and left this one.
The one our master Ibrahim ﵇ addressed as "father" in Surah al-An'am, whom many scholars say was his uncle.
The king who argued with our master Ibrahim ﵇ about giving life and death.
Our master Ibrahim ﵇ said "My Lord gives life and death", and then challenged the king to bring the sun from here (meaning).
The angels ﵈ who visited our master Ibrahim ﵇ were served this meal.
The people of our master Lut ﵇ were destroyed by stones of this.
The family member of our master Lut ﵇ who was not saved.
The House that Ibrahim and Isma'il ﵉ raised.
Iblis said he was better than our master Adam ﵇ because he was made from this.
Our master Adam ﵇ is called this, meaning "father of mankind".
The Blessed Prophet who, after our master Adam ﵇, is called the first Messenger sent to the people of earth.
Our master Nuh ﵇ was told to take into the Ark a pair of this.
The idols of our master Nuh's ﵇ people, five named in Surah Nuh, include Wadd, Suwa', Yaghuth, Ya'uq and this.
Ibn 'Abbas ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمَا)⁩ said those idols were named after these people of our master Nuh's ﵇ time.
The people of our master Hud ﵇ lived in this region, by the common view.
The surah named after the dunes where 'Ad lived.
Our master Salih's ﵇ people were destroyed by this.
The she-camel of our master Salih ﵇ was to share this with the people by turns.
Our master Ibrahim ﵇ reasoned with his people about a star, the moon and this.
Our master Ibrahim ﵇ asked Allah to show him how He gives life to the dead, using these.
Our master Ibrahim ﵇ left our lady Hajar and Isma'il ﵇ in a valley described as having no this.
Our master Ishaq's ﵇ son, also a Blessed Prophet ﵇, given as good news with him.
The town of our master Lut's ﵇ people, named in the reports.
The Blessed Prophet ﵇ who said "I am leaving for my Lord; He will guide me" (meaning).
The surah named after our master Ibrahim ﵇.
Our master Ibrahim ﵇ is called this "nation" in Surah al-Nahl, a model of faith.
The religion of our master Ibrahim ﵇ is described as this, turning away from falsehood.
The number of times our master Ibrahim ﵇ said words that were not literally true, explained by scholars as allusions.
items.src: Sahih al-Bukhari, Book of the Prophets

items.q: Our master Adam ﵇ lived to this age, according to a hadith.
The time between Adam and Nuh ﵉, according to a hadith.
The word for the statues of our master Ibrahim's ﵇ people in Surah al-Anbiya'.
The valley of Thamud, where our Beloved Prophet ﷺ told the army not to drink the water on the way to Tabuk.
Our master Salih's ﵇ people were given this many days before the punishment.
In Surah al-Naml, nine men of mischief plotted at night against this Blessed Prophet ﵇.
Our master Ibrahim ﵇ migrated with his wife Sarah and Lut ﵇ to this land.
Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ said our master Ibrahim ﵇ was the first to host guests, the first to be circumcised and the first to see this (meaning).
Our Beloved Master ﷺ said our master Ibrahim ﵇ circumcised himself at this age (paraphrased).
The angels ﵈ told our master Ibrahim ﵇ they had been sent to the people of this Blessed Prophet ﵇.
Our master Ibrahim ﵇ argued with the angels on behalf of our master Lut's ﵇ people; the Qur'an calls him this.
Our Beloved Prophet ﷺ saw our master Ibrahim ﵇ on the Mi'raj in this heaven.
On the Mi'raj, Ibrahim ﵇ was leaning against this.
Our Beloved Prophet ﷺ saw our master Idris ﵇ on the Mi'raj in this heaven.
Our Beloved Master ﷺ saw our master Adam ﵇ in this heaven.
Our Beloved Prophet ﷺ said He ﷺ was the answer to the prayer of this Blessed Prophet ﵇.
items.src: Musnad Ahmad (hadith of al-'Irbad ibn Sariyah)

items.q: The prayer of our master Ibrahim ﵇ for a Messenger from among the people of Makkah is in this surah.
Our master Ibrahim ﵇ prayed for this city to be made safe.
Our master Ibrahim ﵇ was told to call people to this, and they would come on foot and on lean camels.
The first House set up for mankind to worship in, according to Surah Al 'Imran, is at this place.
Iblis asked to be given respite until this day.
The phrase our master Adam ﵇ and Hawwa' ﵍ said in repentance begins "Our Lord, we have wronged" these (meaning).
Our Beloved Prophet ﷺ said our master Adam ﵇ was created on this day of the week.
The surah in which our master Nuh ﵇ tells his people to seek forgiveness, and Allah will send rain.
In Surah Hud, the water came when this "boiled over".
Our master Nuh's ﵇ wife and Lut's ﵇ wife are given in Surah al-Tahrim as examples of this.
The Blessed Prophet ﵇ who said to his people, "Will you not fear Allah? I am a trustworthy Messenger to you" (meaning), in Surah al-Shu'ara' first.
Our master Ibrahim ﵇ asked his people whether their idols hear them, or do this for them.
Our master Ibrahim ﵇ said, "I am sick" (meaning), on the day of their festival, in this surah.
The father of our master Ibrahim ﵇ threatened to do this to him.
Our master Ibrahim ﵇ promised his father to ask forgiveness for him until it became clear he was this.
The well of Zamzam was later dug again by this grandfather of our Beloved Master ﷺ.
The tribe that settled near our lady Hajar and Isma'il ﵇, and he married from it.
items.src: Sahih al-Bukhari, Book of the Prophets

items.q: Our master Ibrahim ﵇ told our master Isma'il's ﵇ first wife to tell him to change this.
items.src: Sahih al-Bukhari, Book of the Prophets

items.q: The station where our master Ibrahim ﵇ stood while building.
Our master Isma'il ﵇ is described in Surah Maryam as true to this.
The angels ﵈ gave our master Ibrahim ﵇ good news of a "forbearing boy", in this surah.
Our master Lut's ﵇ people were the first to commit this, as their Blessed Prophet ﵇ said (meaning).
items.a: An indecency no one before them had done

items.q: The angels ﵈ told our master Lut ﵇ the punishment would come at this time.
The two Blessed Prophets ﵈ whose "suhuf" (scrolls) are named at the end of Surah al-A'la.
In a report of Abu Dharr ﵁, four Arab Blessed Prophets ﵈ are named: Hud, Salih, Shu'ayb and this one.
items.src: Sahih Ibn Hibban; to be checked

items.q: The city our master Ibrahim ﵇ came from, by the common view of historians.
